prompt: Modern cozy pixel art. A cute chibi character, exactly 2 heads tall: a big round head about as tall as the whole body below it, short stubby limbs, like a classic cute RPG sprite. Ancient Chinese wuxia (martial arts world) setting. A loud, cheeky middle-aged street-food seller running a sales promotion, an original cartoon face (not any real person): short dark-brown hair swept back, a big confident toothy grin, eyebrows raised, slightly squinting eyes. He wears a black short martial-arts jacket with the sleeves rolled up, a white apron with a blue trim line, dark trousers, black-and-white cloth shoes. He holds a round bamboo tray piled with golden-brown round sesame flatbreads on one arm, and with the other hand holds a rolled paper cone like a megaphone to his mouth side, calling out to customers. Palette, strictly: hair #3A2A20 with highlight #5C4434; jacket #1E1E26 with highlight #34343F and outline #0E0E14; apron #FFFFFF with shading #D8D8E0 and trim #3B82F6; trousers #2A2A30; shoes #15151A and #FFFFFF; paper cone #F4EBD6 with shading #CDBF9F; tray #C9A26A with weave #A07C48; flatbreads #E0A040 with crust #B87420 and sesame #FFF4D6; skin #F2C9A8 with shading #DFA07E. Like a Stardew Valley style character sprite blown up large: crisp pixel edges, selective dark outlines, hue-shifted shading with cool shadows and warm highlights, soft light from the top left. Bold simple shapes with about 14 colours so it still reads clearly when shrunk to 90 pixels tall. Full body, front view, standing, centred, filling about 75% of the image height. A small flat pixel shadow under the feet. Background: one flat solid colour #E6E6EA, nothing else. Square image. No text, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers anywhere. No watermark, no signature, no frame, no border. No anti-aliasing blur, every pixel the same size, no gradients, no 3D render, no photo, no green anywhere, no teal, no extra characters, no clutter.
